target.title: fix(codex-supervisor): handle stdout/stderr stream errors in stdio transport
target.body:
## Summary

- add stdout/stderr `error` handlers for Codex Supervisor stdio JSON-RPC transport
- reuse the existing transport failure path and close the stdio child process on readable stream failure
- cover stdout and stderr stream errors with a focused JSON-RPC client regression test
- collision check: `extensions/codex-supervisor/src/json-rpc-client.ts` has open PR #88550, but that diff is isolated to WebSocket compression; no open PR was found for the stdio stdout/stderr stream-error issue

## Verification

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex-supervisor/src/json-rpc-client.test.ts` — passed; 1 file, 1 test passed

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: Codex Supervisor stdio transport parsed JSON-RPC frames from child stdout and tracked stderr tail data, but did not handle readable stream `error`, so an `EPIPE` could bypass the connection failure handling.
Real environment tested: mocked Codex app-server stdio child process using Node `PassThrough` streams in Vitest; no real Codex daemon was required.
Exact steps or command run after this patch: emitted `error` on mocked stdout and stderr streams while `connectCodexAppServerEndpoint` was initializing a stdio endpoint.
Evidence after fix: each emitted stream error did not throw out of band, rejected initialization with `EPIPE`, and terminated the child process with `SIGTERM`.
Observed result after fix: stdio transport stream failures fail the JSON-RPC connection through the existing pending-request rejection path.
What was not tested: full CI and a live Codex app-server stdio session.
